$comment: Harness rules for www.reynoldsamerican.com (home page pilot). Schema: templates/site.json.
name: reynoldsamerican
$freezeCss: has-parallax covers use background-attachment:fixed, which does not paint into section crops (the GROWING TOMORROW crop came out blank). Measure both sides with scroll attachment; the rebuild's .parallax hook gets the same rule.
$invisible: stock quote (live feed on the source, static placeholder in the rebuild): kept in layout, excluded from pixel and style comparison on both sides (intake decision)
$prepare: native <video> has no poster on the source: pause every video on frame 0 so the source shows the same frame as the rebuild's poster (extracted from frame 0 of the same file; intake video policy: poster only)

prepare.js: Promise.all([...document.querySelectorAll('video')].map((v) => new Promise((r) => { v.removeAttribute('autoplay'); v.loop = false; v.pause(); const seek = () => { v.pause(); v.currentTime = 0; v.addEventListener('seeked', r, { once: true }); }; if (v.readyState >= 2) seek(); else v.addEventListener('loadeddata', seek, { once: true }); setTimeout(r, 8000); })))
